Static GitHub Pages export with dynamic repository paths

features.name: Static home-screen metadata
features.description: Traditional Chinese manifest and icons with repository-aware URLs, without a service worker or offline cache.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest and icons export under local/current/renamed paths
No additional dependencies or offline runtime
features.evidence: Implemented at 7e47cd9; metadata tests and export checker cover paths and PNG dimensions. Physical installation and actual browser zoom remain untested.

features.name: Lightweight project-specific agent harness
features.description: Short agent contract, factual feature state, fail-fast cross-platform verification and restartable session handoff.
acceptance_criteria: No placeholder backlog or application changes
npm run verify executes every existing quality gate
Current evidence and remaining gaps are recorded
features.evidence: 2026-10-01: npm run verify and Git Bash init.sh passed all gates, 25 tests, and 70 exported asset references. Injected failing first gate stopped immediately with exit 23. Renamed-prefix build/export passed. Structural validator: instructions/state/verification/scope/lifecycle each 5/5 (100/100); not an effectiveness benchmark.

features.name: Question and review material from source images
features.description: Faithfully transcribe the 79 supplied images into source-backed practice sets and a simple review reader.
acceptance_criteria: Only explicit complete MCQs become practice questions
Notes retain readable source text and original imagery
Existing source set and saved progress unchanged
features.evidence: 2026-10-01: all79 images visually transcribed and preserved with SHA-256 inventory; 86 new explicit-answer MCQs (28/58) and 48 review pages. npm run verify passed validation/lint/typecheck/36 tests/build/243 export refs; renamed prefix passed. 375px reading/resume, keyboard original-image controls and independent question progress checked. Missing national4-3/4-4 and ambiguous source annotations documented; existing114 dataset and progress helpers unchanged.
